title: Recurrence
description: A repeating event schedule calculated in UTC. Named frequencies use UTC calendar units; ISO 8601 frequencies specify a repeating duration. Interval multiplies either frequency form and is treated as 1 when omitted. At least one of interval or daysOfWeek is required; daysOfWeek requires weekly frequency. Events start on or after startsAt and, when supplied, on or before endsAt; endsAt must not precede startsAt.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this recurrence.

entityType.description: Entity type discriminator. Always "Recurrence" for Recurrence entities.

startsAt.description: UTC timestamp anchoring the recurrence and its earliest permitted event start.

endsAt.description: Inclusive UTC limit on event start times; omission leaves the recurrence unbounded.

frequency.description: Named UTC calendar frequency or a strictly positive ISO 8601 repeating duration.

interval.description: Positive multiplier applied to the frequency; treated as 1 when omitted.

daysOfWeek.description: UTC weekday filter for weekly event starts; requires weekly frequency. Weeks begin on Monday.

duration.description: Event duration overriding When.duration; omission inherits the schedule default, not frequency.
Nonnegative ISO 8601 duration in component notation; fractions occur only on the smallest unit.
